focus.zh: 多模态学习 · 强化学习

introduction.en: I study how models reason with language and images, and how a robot can tell when it has reasoned enough to act.
introduction.zh: 我研究模型如何利用语言和图像进行推理，以及机器人如何判断何时可以结束推理、开始行动。

biography.en: I earned my PhD in computer science at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences and carried out postdoctoral research at Tsinghua University.
biography.zh: 我在中国科学院大学获得计算机科学博士学位，之后在清华大学开展博士后研究。

summary.en: What does a model retain before it writes an answer? I work on training and testing intermediate states, including whether one state can support several follow-up questions.
summary.zh: 在写出答案之前，模型保留了哪些信息？我研究中间状态的训练和评测，特别关注同一份状态能否支持多个不同的后续问题。

summary.en: I study how robot policies turn visual observations and instructions into actions, from choosing among several internal plans to deciding when to stop deliberating.
summary.zh: 我研究机器人如何将视觉观测和语言指令转化为动作，包括怎样比较多个内部计划，以及何时结束推理并执行动作。

name.zh: 具身大脑模型的预训练

summary.en: I want to pretrain models that learn from watching people and from a robot’s own attempts. My aim is for a robot to connect an instruction to the scene in front of it and anticipate how its actions will change that scene. In an unfamiliar room, it could then draw on that experience to work out how to use a new tool.
summary.zh: 我希望用人的示范和机器人自己的尝试来预训练具身模型，让机器人能把指令和眼前的场景联系起来，预判自己的动作会带来什么变化。我期待它走进陌生的房间时，也能借助已有经验摸索出使用新工具的方法。

summary.en: I’m interested in how robots decide what to do when something unexpected happens. If a cup is missing from its usual spot, should a robot look more closely, search elsewhere, or ask someone? I’d like it to recognize what information it needs, revise its plan as it finds new clues, and remember what worked for next time.
summary.zh: 我想探索机器人遇到意外时如何作出判断。比如，杯子不在原处，它该再仔细看一眼、换个地方找，还是开口问人？我希望它能判断自己还缺什么信息，根据新线索调整计划，并记住哪些做法值得下次再试。

text.en: Our new preprint studies whether keyboard and mouse events from human gameplay can help pretrain a robot policy.
text.zh: 我们发布了游戏数据预训练预印本，研究玩家的键盘和鼠标操作能否帮助训练机器人策略。

text.en: We updated MPCoT with experiments on a bimanual robot. The policy compares several latent plans before decoding an action.
text.zh: MPCoT 更新了双臂机器人的实机实验。策略会先比较多条潜在计划，再解码动作。

text.en: Two papers on latent reasoning appeared at ICML and ACL, one on early exit for robot policies and one on soft reasoning tokens for language models.
text.zh: 两项潜空间推理工作分别发表于 ICML 和 ACL，研究机器人策略中的提前退出，以及语言模型中的连续推理表示。

papers.title: MOSAIC: Adaptive Inter-layer Composition for Efficient Heterogeneous Vision-Language Models

summary.en: MOSAIC selects an attention mechanism and a feed-forward network width for each layer of a vision-language model to meet a latency budget on the target hardware. It then uses two stages of distillation to recover model performance.
summary.zh: MOSAIC 按目标硬件的推理延迟预算，为视觉语言模型的每一层选择注意力机制和前馈网络宽度，再通过两阶段知识蒸馏恢复模型性能。

papers.title: Think Less, Act Early: Reinforced Latent Reasoning with Early Exit in Vision-Language-Action Models

summary.en: A robot policy learns to stop its internal reasoning when its state is confident enough to decode an action.
summary.zh: 机器人策略根据中间状态的置信度决定何时停止推理并输出动作。

papers.title: Self-SoftCoT: A Self-Consistent Framework via Position-Aware Latent Space Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: A frozen language model generates and consumes its own continuous reasoning tokens. Position-specific projections give successive thoughts distinct representations.
summary.zh: 冻结的语言模型生成并读取自己的连续推理表示。不同位置采用独立投影，使相邻推理步骤能够保留不同的信息。

papers.title: F2Net: A Frequency-Fused Network for Ultra-High Resolution Remote Sensing Segmentation

summary.en: Frequency-specific branches preserve fine boundaries and gather scene context before fusing their features for aerial image segmentation.
summary.zh: 用不同分支处理高频边界和低频场景信息，再融合两者完成超高分辨率遥感图像分割。

papers.title: Thinking on the Fly: Test-Time Reasoning Enhancement via Latent Thought Policy Optimization

summary.en: LTPO refines latent thought vectors for each new problem using a reward derived from the model’s own output confidence.
summary.zh: LTPO 在测试时利用模型自身的输出置信度作为奖励，针对每道新题优化潜在思维向量。

papers.title: FlexDataset: Crafting Annotated Dataset Generation for Diverse Applications

summary.en: Given object categories and bounding boxes, FlexDataset generates scenes containing multiple objects along with pixel-level annotations such as segmentation masks and depth maps.
summary.zh: 给定物体类别和边界框，FlexDataset 可以生成包含多个物体的场景图像，以及与图像对应的分割掩码、深度图等像素级标注。

papers.title: Game-Enhanced Embodied Learning with Event and Foresight Pretraining

summary.en: A robot policy learns from gameplay recordings to anticipate the player’s next keyboard or mouse input and how the scene will change. We then fine-tune the policy on robot demonstrations and evaluate it on manipulation tasks in LIBERO.
summary.zh: 我们用游戏录像预训练机器人策略，让它预测玩家接下来的键鼠操作和画面变化，再用机器人示范微调，并在 LIBERO 的操作任务上评估迁移效果。

papers.title: NewtonGS: Physics-Structured Object-Level Neural Newtonian Dynamics for Gaussian Scene Animation

summary.en: NewtonGS combines Newtonian mechanics with learned corrections to predict each object’s motion and contact with the floor. It uses the resulting poses and scales to animate objects in a 3D Gaussian scene.
summary.zh: NewtonGS 结合牛顿力学和从数据中学到的修正项，预测物体如何运动、如何与地面接触，再用预测的姿态和尺度驱动三维高斯场景中的物体动画。

papers.title: Masked Diffusion Decoding as x-Prediction Flow

summary.en: A masked diffusion language model refines each token’s representation over several decoding steps. Confidence sets the pace at each position, so the model can revise earlier predictions as the surrounding text takes shape.
summary.zh: 掩码扩散语言模型在多个解码步骤中逐步更新每个词元的表示。各位置的更新速度取决于预测置信度，模型可以随上下文逐渐明朗而修正先前的预测。

papers.title: Cognitive Memory in Large Language Models

summary.en: A survey of how language models store, update and retrieve information through text, key–value caches, model parameters and hidden states.
summary.zh: 综述语言模型如何通过文本、键值缓存、模型参数和隐藏状态存储、更新及检索信息。
